rationale: The assistant correctly identified the sump/pump and float theory, used the customer's evidence (slimy filter, stacking, partial improvement after cleaning), and offered a safer unplugged test, with escalation to Bosch or an engineer if the fault persists. It repeated the door-rim label and pump-test advice across turns, and the earlier suggestion to tilt the dryer was later corrected. The pour-water test is reasonable but somewhat risky for a nervous user, though it was framed with the power off. No part was recommended without the model number.
